# Ray Excavation & Demolition

> Excavation, dirt work and demolition company owned and operated by Willie Ray, serving Kaufman County, Texas and surrounding areas (including Forney, Terrell, Kaufman, Crandall, Kemp, Mabank and Scurry). Free estimates: call or text (214) 405-5621.

## Services

- Ponds & dams: new ponds dug, old ponds cleaned out and deepened, dams built and repaired
- Proper drainage (our specialty): grading and shaping land so water runs away from homes, shops and driveways
- House pads: compacted pads for new home foundations, set at the right height and grade
- Shop pads: level, compacted pads for shops, barns and garages
- New construction final grades: finish grading around new homes and buildings
- Gravel driveways: new gravel driveways and roads, re-grading and fresh rock
- Land clearing: trees, brush and stumps cleared for building or pasture
- Demolition of all types: houses, mobile homes, outbuildings, pools and concrete, hauled off and cleaned up
- Light commercial & residential work for homeowners, landowners, builders and small businesses
